top_signals.title: Conflict must not distract from climate action, leaders warn COP31
top_signals.summary: COP31 host Turkey has been pushing for a goal to expand electrification at the center of a deal, even as critics say it may do little to curb warming.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia perps plunge 10% on Hyperliquid as board reportedly weighs ousting Jensen Huang
top_signals.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang over two extramarital affairs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
